entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Follow up work items for extension operators #79136
  • the new keyword "extension" (preview in C# 14) hasn't been supported properly in VS2022 #79133
  • Possible bug in NullabilityRewriter code generator #79132
  • Unnecessary Convert Expression Generated when Type is Constrained to Interface #79130

Closed

  • In RoslynAnalyzers, change Microsoft.CodeAnalysis package references to project references #78643
  • `extension` block doesn't allow `extern` #78572
    Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10724.52 #79127
